SELECT c.commentID AS commentId, c.userID AS userId, u.nickname AS nickname, u.imgUrl AS avatarUrl, c.commentText AS commentText, c.likeCount AS likeCount, c.dislikeCount AS dislikeCount, c.gmtCreate AS gmtCreate FROM comment c LEFT JOIN `user` u ON c.userID = u.userID WHERE c.videoID = #{videoId} AND c.enable = 1
ORDER BY c.gmtCreate DESC, c.commentID DESC ORDER BY c.likeCount DESC, c.gmtCreate DESC
